parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval for molecules in clinical development phases 3 or 4. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records as an INNER JOIN to enforce at least one compound record. Left join compound_structures to include canonical_smiles, allowing nulls for molecules without stored structures. Filter by max_phase in (3, 4). Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval.
